# Mega Move India

> Mega Move India Private Limited is an Indian project logistics and heavy-haulage company headquartered in Mumbai. It moves over-dimensional (ODC), heavy-lift and project cargo by road, sea and air, with its own fleet of hydraulic axle trailers, and provides freight forwarding, customs clearance, transport engineering, factory relocation and equipment rental across India and worldwide.

Key facts:
- Head office: A-wing, Office No 905, Pranik Chambers, Sakivihar Road, Sakinaka, Andheri East, Mumbai 400072, Maharashtra, India
- Branch offices: Vapi (Gujarat), Hisar (Haryana), Chennai (Tamil Nadu)
- Phone: +91 93213 99970 · Email: info@megamoveindia.com
- In-house fleet: 40 hydraulic axle lines, 18 lowbed trailers, 10 flatbed trailers, 4 heavy-duty pullers, 2 HAV 15 m spacers
- Customers include Reliance Industries, Tata Power, Siemens Energy, L&T Heavy Engineering, UPMRC (Kanpur Metro), Polycab, TBEA, Royal IHC and Zeeco
- Industries served: power and energy, oil and gas, infrastructure, metal and mining, industrial plants, rental and warehousing

## Services

- [ODC Transport](https://megamoveindia.com/odc-transport/): over-dimensional and heavy cargo transport on hydraulic axle and lowbed trailers, with permits, route surveys and escorts
- [Project Forwarding](https://megamoveindia.com/services/project-forwarding/): breakbulk, out-of-gauge and heavy-lift project cargo, door to site
- [Ocean Freight](https://megamoveindia.com/services/ocean-freight/): FCL, LCL, breakbulk and project cargo shipping
- [Air Freight](https://megamoveindia.com/services/air-freight/): import and export air cargo, air charter, project cargo airlift
- [Transport Engineering](https://megamoveindia.com/services/transport-engineering/): route surveys, bridge analysis, cargo securing and lifting plans
- [Factory Relocation](https://megamoveindia.com/services/factory-relocation/): dismantling, packing, shipping and reinstallation of industrial plants
- [Transshipment](https://megamoveindia.com/services/transshipment/): hub routing for containers, breakbulk and project cargo
- [Logistics & Supply Chain](https://megamoveindia.com/services/logistics-supply-chain/): customs clearance, port handling, documentation, dunnage and lashing
- [Equipment Rentals & Warehousing](https://megamoveindia.com/services/rentals-warehousing/): truck mounted manlifts, aerial lifts, warehousing and cargo handling

## Case studies

- [BMP-II defence vehicles to Nyoma, Ladakh](https://megamoveindia.com/case-studies/national-defence-project/): about 3,700 km of ODC transport in 21 days
- [Kanpur Metro tunnel boring machines](https://megamoveindia.com/case-studies/Project-10/): 400 MT from Kandla Port to Kanpur on 13 Super ODC vehicles
- [2 x 100 MT heat exchangers to IOCL Panipat](https://megamoveindia.com/case-studies/Project-5/)
- [225 MT used machinery, JNPT to Chakan](https://megamoveindia.com/case-studies/Project-2/)
- [Six 42 MT X-ray systems, Germany to ONGC Barmer](https://megamoveindia.com/case-studies/Project-7/): delivered in 49 days
- [Eight 32 MT machinery packages for Tata Power, Hamburg to Bangalore](https://megamoveindia.com/case-studies/Project-9/)
- [Factory relocation, Germany to Navi Mumbai](https://megamoveindia.com/case-studies/Project-3/)
- [All case studies](https://megamoveindia.com/case-studies/)
